name: video-to-spec
description: Marketplace for the video-to-spec plugin: convert screen recordings into spec-driven development specifications.

plugins.name: video-to-spec
plugins.description: Turn a screen-recording video (local file or YouTube link) into a spec-driven development specification (Spec Kit spec.md with EARS requirements, user stories, success criteria, and clarifications) plus screen-by-screen UI evidence, using scene-detection screenshots and audio transcription.
